error[ZBX-E0225]: can't bind that device into the container
  while  looking at the device /dev/dri/renderD128
  cause  /dev/dri/renderD128 is not on this host
  device /dev/dri/renderD128
  fix    list the nodes the host has, and give one of them:   ls -l /dev/dri
  more   zbx explain E0225
  docs   https://zigbox.github.io/zigbox/errors/E0225.html
